server: kind-fathom-oracle, kindest/node v1.37.0, kubectl client v1.36.4
mapServed: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1 serves ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and MutatingAdmissionPolicy (both v1, no v1beta1, no feature gate needed on 1.37); no second cluster created

scenarios.name: vap-deny-violation
scenarios.serverMessage: The deployments "vap-deny-violation" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'vap-deny' with binding 'vap-deny-binding' denied request: replicas 5 exceeds maxReplicas 3 from ConfigMap vap-limits
scenarios.notes: replicas 5 > maxReplicas 3 AND team label mismatch: both validations fail, but Deny reports only the first denied decision (compare vap-warn, which surfaces both). Reason Invalid -> 'is invalid'.

scenarios.name: vap-deny-pass
scenarios.notes: replicas 2, team=shop matches namespace label; authorizer check for cluster-admin (kubernetes-admin) is allowed.

scenarios.name: vap-deny-excluded
scenarios.notes: Would violate (replicas 5, team=other) but label fathom.dev/skip-vap makes matchCondition exclude-opted-out false; nothing evaluated.

scenarios.name: vap-warn
serverWarnings: Warning: Validation failed for ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'vap-deny' with binding 'vap-warn-binding': replicas 5 exceeds maxReplicas 3 from ConfigMap vap-limits
Warning: Validation failed for ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'vap-deny' with binding 'vap-warn-binding': deployments in a prod namespace must carry the namespace's team label
scenarios.notes: Same policy, binding vap-warn-binding with [Warn, Audit]: object allowed, one Warning line per failed validation (2).

scenarios.name: vap-param-missing
scenarios.serverMessage: The deployments "vap-param-missing" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'vap-deny' with binding 'vap-param-missing-binding' denied request: failed to configure binding: no params found for policy binding with `Deny` parameterNotFoundAction
scenarios.notes: paramRef name vap-limits-does-not-exist, parameterNotFoundAction Deny: denied before any validation runs; message is the binding-configuration failure.

scenarios.name: map-apply
scenarios.notes: ApplyConfiguration adds label fathom.dev/mutated-by=map-apply and spec.template.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true; kubectl apply (client-side) also adds the last-applied annotation.

scenarios.name: map-jsonpatch
scenarios.notes: kubectl apply sends the last-applied annotation, so metadata.annotations exists and the JSONPatch takes the add-key branch (/metadata/annotations/fathom.dev~1patched-by).

scenarios.name: map-jsonpatch-create
scenarios.notes: Same object via kubectl create --dry-run=server: no annotations on the request, JSONPatch takes the add-whole-map branch (/metadata/annotations).

scenarios.name: map-reinvoke
scenarios.notes: Alphabetical order: map-reinvoke-1-reader runs first and would record tier-seen=unset; map-reinvoke-2-setter sets label fathom.dev/tier=backend; reader (reinvocationPolicy IfNeeded) is reinvoked and the final object has annotation fathom.dev/tier-seen=backend.
